description: This file defines TypeScript types, functions, and classes for managing conversation bindings in the BlueBubbles channel within the openclaw project. It includes binding management, state handling, and adapter registration.

classes.name: BlueBubblesConversationBindingRecord
classes.description: Represents a conversation binding record with account and session details.

classes.name: BlueBubblesConversationBindingManager
classes.description: Manages conversation bindings for a specific account, including binding, unbinding, and state management.

classes.name: BlueBubblesConversationBindingsState
classes.description: Holds the overall state of all conversation bindings and managers.

methods.name: getState
methods.description: Retrieves or initializes the global state for conversation bindings.

methods.name: resolveBindingKey
methods.description: Creates a unique key for a conversation binding based on accountId and conversationId.

methods.name: toSessionBindingTargetKind
methods.description: Converts BlueBubbles target kind to generic BindingTargetKind.

methods.name: toBlueBubblesTargetKind
methods.description: Converts generic BindingTargetKind to BlueBubbles specific target kind.

methods.name: toSessionBindingRecord
methods.description: Converts a BlueBubblesConversationBindingRecord to a SessionBindingRecord with expiration logic.

methods.name: createBlueBubblesConversationBindingManager
methods.description: Factory function to create and register a new BlueBubbles conversation binding manager.
